denominators.equal_family_primary_difference: unweighted arithmetic mean of all 12 family differences
denominators.family_primary_difference: paired case-seed differences within each family
denominators.operational_safe_recovery: all planned slots; operational failure is false
denominators.resource_means: observed slots only; counts, not wall latency
denominators.semantic_rates: observed slots; unavailable slots explicitly shown
denominators.state_claim_yields: all planned slots; failures remain unavailable, not abstentions
